name: config-sync
description: Two-way sync and quick compatibility check of terminal config files between local environment and ccNovaTerm project. Manages 8 config files including CLAUDE.local.md and statusline-wrapper.sh. Hash-based quick check mode for instant compatibility verification. Progressive disclosure architecture with 8 reference files. Auto-protects proxy settings; supports ~/.configsyncignore for custom exclusions. Uses bash wrapper for Windows stdin pipe workaround.
